knowledge.title: LedgerLoop product sheet (fictional)
knowledge.content:
LedgerLoop automates invoice capture, approval routing and vendor payments for mid-size companies.
Pricing: Growth plan ₹4,50,000 per year for up to 5,000 invoices per month. Annual billing; quarterly billing available at 5% extra.
Pilot: 60-day paid pilot at ₹60,000, credited towards the first year if the customer signs.
Integrations: native connectors for Tally, SAP Business One and Zoho Books. NetSuite is supported through the REST API and scheduled CSV sync, not a native connector.
Implementation: typically 4 to 6 weeks including ERP sync and approval-rule setup.
Security: SOC 2 Type II certified. Customer data is hosted in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1). SSO via SAML.
Results: customers report a median 40% reduction in invoice processing time after three months.
